The Bantam TKO-C was designed in conjunction with top pickleball pro, Christian Alshon, to provide a combination of power, spin, and reach. PT-700 unidirectional raw carbon fiber is combined with our legendary Bantam core to give serious players max power and spin capability. A 16.5" overall paddle length increases speed at the point of contact—exponentially increasing power with every hit.
Weight specifications will be within 1/10th of an ounce.
